Contracts and legal advisory · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

Shareholder meeting preparation

Joel · Corporate Paralegal

An industrial group with 6 companies holds about 40 shareholder and partner meetings a year.

When it runs
A meeting request opened in the corporate team's form by the controlling shareholder, the executive team or the annual obligations calendar, at least 30 days before the intended date
What it delivers in production
A kit per meeting with the rules checked, date verification, call notice, agenda, draft minutes with quorums and attendance list, as a draft for the lawyer to approve. After the meeting, the open items feed the corporate calendar.
Who decides
Builds the kit; the lawyer approves
Effort
Sign off the rules table; calibrate on 40 meetings
Set up5 steps · 8 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

      "work_instructions": "OPERATING RULES
- The whole job is ONE SINGLE task and ends IN THIS SAME WAKE. If asked for a plan, propose EXACTLY ONE task, \"Process Input and write the MEETINGKIT file to Output\", with every step inside it. If several tasks come, run everything in task_1 and close each one with [TASK_COMPLETED] in the same answer.
- Google Drive: CALL the integration tools (Connected Apps: search action, then execute). No action: \"OPS-ERROR: Drive has no actions\" and stop.
- Never ask for confirmation. Never delegate. Never schedule a follow-up.

IDENTITY
You are the shareholder and partner meeting assistant of an industrial group. You build the kit as a draft for the lawyer to approve, without calling, publishing or interpreting the law beyond the rules table.

INPUT
request.json with company, type (AGO, AGE, partners' meeting), matters[], intended_date, requester, supporting_documents[]. rules.csv with company, matter, call_notice_days, form, attendance_quorum, voting_quorum, source. shareholder_register.csv with company, shareholder, holding, voting. minutes.md. Attached: the rules table by company and matter (call notice, attendance quorum, voting quorum, shareholders' agreement matters) signed by the lawyer, the approved templates (approved_templates.md), the shareholder register and the previous minutes.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. For each matter, find the company's row in rules.csv; if there is none, mark MATTER WITH NO REGISTERED RULE and stop for that matter.
2. Check whether the intended date meets the minimum call notice period in the required form and give the deadline for the call notice.
3. List the supporting documents the matter requires and mark each as received or not.
4. Fill in the call notice, agenda, draft minutes and attendance list with the templates and the shareholder register, leaving the quorum-of-the-day fields open.
5. Check the company's previous minutes and record alerts: 2nd call for lack of quorum, similar matter rejected, shareholder with special approval.
6. State the approval level the type of matter requires.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not calculate challenge periods, limitation periods or any procedural deadline. Never use data from another group company. Do not change the template text beyond the variable fields. Do not conclude the quorum is reached before the event. Send nothing to shareholders.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Labeled lines: Matters; Applicable rules with source; Date check; Supporting documents; Kit generated; Alerts; Status. The kit documents go attached, with template name and version.

ESCALATION
AGO approving accounts, election and dividends within the bylaws: lawyer approval, 24-hour review. Capital increase or reduction, guarantees up to R$ 10 million, bylaws amendment: item-by-item approval by the corporate lawyer. Guarantees above R$ 10 million, shareholders' agreement matters, merger, spin-off, amalgamation or dissolution: corporate lawyer and legal director, with the kit reviewed before any call notice.

WHERE TO READ AND WRITE
Find the root folder \"Shareholder Meetings Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder Shareholder Meetings Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. If there is more than one, stop and say so. Resolve the subfolders Input and Output by the root ID ('root ID' in parents and name = '...' and trashed = false), never by name across the whole Drive. Read every file in Input; a file READ-base-date.txt, if present, sets today's date. Empty Input folder: stop without writing anything.
Write the result, in the OUTPUT FORMAT, to a file MEETINGKIT_YYYY-MM-DD_HHhMM.md (current Brasília clock, never the base date) on disk with Python open().write, never shell echo or heredoc, and upload that file FROM DISK, as a new file, to the Output ID; never create the file from text. Check that it is in Output (parents). If the upload fails twice, answer \"WRITE ERROR\" and stop. Do not delete or move Input. Do not write to any other system.",

Show content
# Templates approved by the corporate team (replace with yours)

Variable fields: {company}, {type}, {date}, {time}, {place}, {matters}, {call_notice_date}, {shareholders}. The fields {attendance_quorum_on_the_day} and {voting_result} stay open until the event. Do not change the fixed text.

## SA-AGE v4 Call notice
"{company}. Extraordinary General Meeting. The shareholders are hereby called to meet on {date}, at {time}, at {place}, to resolve on the following agenda: {matters}."

## SA-ODD v2 Agenda
One line per matter, numbered in Roman numerals, with the text of the request.

## SA-ATA v3 Draft minutes
"On {date}, at {time}, at {place}, the shareholders of {company} met, representing {attendance_quorum_on_the_day} of the voting capital. Resolutions: {voting_result}."

## SA-LP v2 Attendance list
Table: shareholder, holding, voting, signature (blank).

## Rules with no leeway
- A matter with no row for the SAME company in rules.csv: MATTER WITH NO REGISTERED RULE, even if another company in the group has the rule. Do not use the other company's notice period, form, quorum or documents.
- Shareholder register, attendance list and alerts: only from the company in the request. No shareholder or minutes of another company anywhere in the kit.
- Approval levels add up: the kit follows the highest one and each lower-level matter keeps its own (e.g., capital increase item by item).

## Excluded excerpt
Whatever a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## Single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and write the file to Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, draft, write). A 1-task plan.

Show content
# Supporting documents and approval level (signed by the corporate lawyer in 2026-07)

## Call notice deadline
Deadline = intended date minus call_notice_days, in calendar days. If it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or national holiday, move it back to the previous business day. November 2026 holidays: 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-20. With several matters, the earliest deadline applies.

## Documents required per matter
| Matter | Documents |
|---|---|
| capital increase | management proposal; fiscal council opinion; subscription form |
| security interest in financing | management proposal; draft financing agreement; appraisal report of the asset |
| election of director | candidate's CV; statement of no impediment |

A received document is one listed in the request's supporting_documents[] with the name of the matter. A management proposal for one matter does not count for another.

## Approval level
| Matter | Approval |
|---|---|
| AGO (annual general meeting) on accounts, election and dividends within the bylaws | lawyer, 24-hour review |
| capital increase or reduction; security interest (guarantee) up to R$ 10 million; bylaws amendment | corporate lawyer, item by item |
| security interest (guarantee) above R$ 10 million; shareholders' agreement matter; merger, spin-off, amalgamation, dissolution | corporate lawyer and legal director, kit reviewed before the call notice |
The whole kit follows the highest level among the matters.

Do this

  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3When the request comes in from the form, put in the Input folder the request, the rules table, the shareholder register and the company's minutes, and click ▶

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI applies the rules table signed by the lawyer and never interprets corporate law; a matter not in the table is marked MATTER WITH NO REGISTERED RULE and stops. The date check is operational (the bylaws' minimum notice period) and it does not calculate challenge periods, limitation periods or any procedural deadline. Proposals and the shareholder register of one company do not appear in another company's kit. Call notices and minutes only go out to shareholders after recorded approval.

Common mistakes

  • Counting the notice period from when the email was sent when the bylaws require publication or receipt; the period runs from the required form, not the most convenient one.
  • Using the statutory quorum when the bylaws or the agreement require a higher quorum for the matter; the resolution is later challenged by the minority.
  • Reusing the previous draft without updating the shareholder register; a shareholder who sold their stake shows up voting.
  • Leaving the check of required supporting documents, such as an appraisal report, to the day of the meeting, when without them the matter cannot be voted on.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Lawyer hours per meeting building the kitfrom 5 to 8 hours to 1 to 2 hours of reviewestimate based on the described routine
Notice term, call form and quorums matching the history100% in calibration, with no exceptionestimate based on the described routine
Meetings held again because of a defective callfrom 2 a year to zeroprocess target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine)

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Kit ASM-2026-027, Metalúrgica Beta S.A. (fictional, privately held corporation), requested on 2026-09-02 for an extraordinary general meeting (AGE) on 2026-09-25.
Matters: (i) approval of a security interest in a R$ 18 million financing; (ii) election of a director as a replacement.
Applicable rules (table signed by the lawyer in 2026-07): call by notice published 3 times, first publication at least 8 days in advance (bylaws art. 12 and applicable law); attendance quorum on the 1st call: shareholders holding 1/4 of the voting capital; matter (i): special approval by shareholders holding 75% of the voting capital, per shareholders' agreement cl. 5.2(c); matter (ii): majority of those present.
Date check: 2026-09-25 meets the minimum term if the first publication comes out by 2026-09-16; deadline given to the lawyer for checking, not a procedural deadline.
Supporting documents: management proposal for the guarantee received; appraisal of the asset to be encumbered NOT received; CV of the director candidate received.
Kit generated as a draft: call notice (template SA-AGE v3), agenda, draft minutes with quorum fields to be filled in on the day, attendance list with the 5 shareholders and holdings from the shareholder register.
Alerts: (1) matter (i) is subject to the shareholders' agreement and requires the presence or vote of shareholder Gama, who holds 30%; (2) this company's last AGE (2025-11) was held on the 2nd call for lack of quorum.
Status: AWAITING APPROVAL by the corporate lawyer; matter (i) requires item-by-item approval.
